sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: []{#sec:intro label="sec:intro"} The purpose of the present paper is to introduce the Mukai pairing on the Hochschild homology of smooth, proper spaces. This pairing is the natural analogue, in the context of Hochschild theory, of the Poincaré pairing on the singular cohomology of smooth manifolds. Our approach is categorical. We start with a geometric category, whose objects will be called *spaces*. For a space $X$

sections.title: The 2-category of kernels
sections.extract: In this section we introduce the 2-category ${\mathscr{V}\textsf{ar}}$, which provides the natural context for the study of the structure of integral transforms between derived categories of spaces. The objects of ${\mathscr{V}\textsf{ar}}$ are spaces, 1-morphisms are kernels of integral transforms, and 2-morphisms are maps between these kernels. sections.title: A reminder on 2-categories.
sections.extract: We will review the notion of a 2-category at the same time as introducing the notation we will be using. Recall that a 2-category consists of three levels of structure: objects; 1-morphisms between objects; and 2-morphisms between 1-morphisms. sections.title: The Chern character
sections.extract: []{#sec:chernchar label="sec:chernchar"} In this section we define the Chern character map $\mathop{\mathrm{ch}}\colon \mathop{\mathrm{K}}_0(X) \rightarrow\mathop{\mathrm{HH}}_0(X)$. We discuss the relationship between our construction and the one of Markarian [@Mar Definition 2]. Then we show that the Chern character maps the Euler pairing to the Mukai pairing: we call this the Semi-Hirzebruch-Riemann-Roch Theorem.

sections.title: Open-closed TQFTs and the Cardy Condition
sections.extract: []{#sec:cardy label="sec:cardy"} We conclude with a discussion of open-closed topological field theories in the B-model and we prove that a condition holds for Hochschild homology which is equivalent to the Cardy Condition in the Calabi-Yau case. Appropriate references for open-closed 2d topological field theories include Moore-Segal [@MooSeg], Costello [@Cos] and Lauda-Pfeiffer [@LaudaPfeifer].

sections.title: Open-closed 2d TQFTs.
sections.extract: Consider the open and closed 2-cobordism category $2\textsf{Cob}_{\text{oc}}$ whose objects are oriented, compact one-manifolds --- in other words, disjoint unions of circles and intervals --- and whose morphisms are (diffeomorphism classes of) cobordisms-with-corners between the source and target one-manifolds. A morphism can be drawn as a vertical cobordism, from the source at the bottom to the target at the top.
